say:1:1631953001:1.text: Yes! The Dog God really came through!
say:1:1631953001:1.male: Yes! The Dog God really came through!
say:1:1631953001:1.female: Yes! The Dog God really came through!

say:2:1631953002:1.text: I made a wish to the Dog God that humans would like dogs more.
say:2:1631953002:1.source_cn: 我向狗狗神许愿人类能多喜欢狗狗一点。
say:2:1631953002:1.male: I made a wish to the Dog God that humans would like dogs more.
say:2:1631953002:1.female: I made a wish to the Dog God that humans would like dogs more.

say:3:1631953003:1.text: Later that night, my owner patted my head and said dogs are the cutest animals in the world.
say:3:1631953003:1.source_cn: 结果当晚主人就摸着我的头说狗狗是世界上最可爱的动物。
say:3:1631953003:1.male: Later that night, my owner patted my head and said dogs are the cutest animals in the world.
say:3:1631953003:1.female: Later that night, my owner patted my head and said dogs are the cutest animals in the world.
